jobs.description: Job DescriptionFor more than 30 years, Advancis has been developing innovative software solutions for security and building automation. As one of the international market leaders, our solutions are used worldwide in businesses, critical infrastructures, and complex building environments.As Head of Quality Assurance (m/f/d), you will lead our QA organization and drive the transformation toward a modern, highly automated, and AI-supported quality assurance system. You will lead the QA team at our headquarters in Langen and ensure that our QA team in Ireland operates according to the same structures, processes, and standards. Your focus will be on people management and the strategic development of QA, not on operational testing.Why us?• A leadership role with real creative freedom• A modern, attractive work environment• An open and dynamic corporate culture• An attractive compensation package that includes a share in the company’s success• Flexible work hours• Company health insurance and retirement plan• Benefits such as fitness, massage, yoga, JobRad, or Jobticket• Central office in Langen with excellent public transportation access and plenty of parking and charging options• Regular company eventsYour mission• Provide technical and managerial leadership to the QA team in Langen• Establish consistent QA structures, processes, and standards for the teams in Langen and Ireland• Develop and implement a testing strategy with a clear focus on test automation and the use of AI in the testing process• Consistent expansion of automated testing, including integration into the CI/CD pipelines• Evaluation and implementation of AI-powered tools, such as those for generating test cases, analyzing test results, or maintaining test scripts• Empowering your team to work with automation and AI through coaching, training, and knowledge transfer• Developing and supporting your employees, including performance reviews and goal-setting• Staff planning and recruiting for the QA department• Close collaboration with development leadership, product management, and the Scrum teams• Defining quality metrics (e.g., automation rate, defect rates) and reporting to executive management• Responsibility for quality approval of releasesYour profile• Degree in computer science, mathematics, or a comparable qualification• Several years of experience in software quality assurance, ideally in the context of complex Windows desktop or enterprise applications• Proven leadership experience, ideally with teams across multiple locations or in international teams• Extensive experience in setting up and scaling test automation for Windows desktop applications and web applications• Experience with or a strong interest in the use of AI in quality assurance, as well as a keen sense of where AI delivers real added value• Understanding of CI/CD processes and agile methodologies (Scrum)• Enjoyment of leading people and helping individuals and teams grow• A structured, communicative, and assertive work style• Excellent German and English language skills• Willingness to travel to Ireland occasionallyIn addition to professional expertise, we value leadership, empathy, solution-oriented thinking, and commitment.About usAt Advancis, people are at the heart of everything we do. Our success is built on the ideas, expertise and commitment of our employees. That's why we foster a work environment based on trust, teamwork and mutual respect.We provide the freedom to bring in new ideas, take ownership and grow both professionally and personally. Short decision-making processes, modern working conditions and an open company culture enable everyone to make a real impact.We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We believe the best ideas emerge when different perspectives come together.One Advancis. Shaping the future together.

jobs.occupation: EMEA Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) Senior Business Partner (m/f/d) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Work ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.Position summaryThe EMEA Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) Senior Business Partner serves as the strategic SFE advisor and senior subject matter expert to the EMEA Biosciences (BID) Vice President and Commercial Leadership Team. The role drives commercial excellence and helps shape the BID growth strategy to deliver and exceed the Annual Operating Plan. This will be achieved through advanced data analytics and AI-driven insights, strengthened sales processes and KPIs, and increased adoption of digital tools and CRM capabilities to improve overall commercial effectiveness.As part of the Centre of Excellence for SFE & Training, the role partners with all the Commercial Operations functions working collaboratively across BID to drive a culture of continuous sales improvement and high performance.KEY GOALS & RESPONSIBILITIES:Business Partnership- Partner with and act as the senior SFE business partner and trusted advisor to the EMEA BID Commercial Leadership Team, providing expertise, insights, and constructive challenge to enable effective commercial decision-making.- Shape the EMEA BID SFE strategy and priorities, ensuring alignment with business strategy, growth objectives, and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments.- Proactively identify commercial performance risks and growth opportunities, translating insights into clear recommendations and actionable plans for leadership. Establish and strengthen Sales Representative and District Manager standard work to drive superior commercial performance and deliver financial commitments.- Influence decisions related to sales execution, resource deployment, territory strategy, commercial investments, and growth priorities through fact-based analysis, advanced insights, and strong business acumen.Commercial Performance & Advanced Insights- Deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights, monitor key performance indicators, and advise leadership on emerging trends, performance gaps, and actions required to accelerate growth.- Partner with leadership teams to execute annual growth priorities and quarterly focus programs, leveraging weekly and monthly business reviews to drive accountability, focus, and execution.- Strengthen District Manager leadership capabilities and commercial rigor across funnel and forecast management, territory planning, performance management, and investment prioritization.Subject Matter Expertise & Digital Enablement- Serve as the EMEA BID subject matter expert for Sales Force Effectiveness, providing leadership across key SFE processes, including Customer Connections, funnel management, lead management, business planning, and mobility, as well as enabling platforms such as AI, CRM, data science, quoting, sales enablement, and Power BI reporting.- Partner with global platform and technical teams, acting as the bridge between business requirements and technology capabilities to enable the EMEA SFE strategy and accelerate commercial adoption. Continuously assess emerging analytics, AI, and digital technologies to identify opportunities to enhance sales effectiveness and productivity.- Develop and lead the delivery of training content and enablement programs supporting the sales training curriculum and onboarding for SFE tools and processes, in partnership with the Sales Training and Development team.- Capture, champion, and represent the voice of the sales organization, translating user feedback into improvements that remove barriers to execution and enhance SFE tools, processes, and user experience.- Apply the PPI (Practical Process Improvement) Business System to drive continuous improvement, simplification, and sustained effectiveness across SFE tools and processes.What will you need?- Life Sciences or Business Degree with extensive experience in commercial, commercial operations, business analytics, or related field (Preferred fields: Life Sciences, Business, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering)- Significant progressive experience in commercial, commercial operations, Sales Force Effectiveness, business analytics or a related function within a complex international organization. Proven success in continuous improvement (e.g., Kaizen), sales processes, digital/AI systems and tools, analytics, and change management- Deep knowledge of CRM Salesforce.com and strong AI capabilities- Advanced analytical and data-visualization capabilities, including Power BI and Excel, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear executive-level insights and recommendations. Demonstrated ability to lead major commercial projects and drive process improvement initiatives- Excellent communication, facilitation and storytelling skills, with demonstrated experience presenting recommendations to senior leadership.- Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed and evolving environment, managing ambiguity and exercising a high degree of independent judgment.- Travel up to 10-15% may be required- English proficiency required; additional languages beneficial for international roles
